recommendations.behavior: Brand palette/apply respects inherited locks, style protection and hidden groups; retains geometry and guides.
Alpha-aware ColorField edits shorthand/long RGBA and transparent palette colors.
Brand saves retain original intrinsic dimensions, rights/provenance/public alt and lightweight previews; insertion keeps a fresh canvas ID.
Gallery creation previews all template pages, instantiates declared defaults/required fields and validates content.
Research transfer reads without consuming, accepts against the live library, then acknowledges matching document; owner-scoped pending transfer survives failures.
Onboarding resumes fields and step in sessionStorage for 24 hours, including checkout cancellation; existing channel is reused.
Creation dialog configures format/custom pixels, 1–20 blank pages, separate/continuous canvas and Brand; templates explicitly retain their page count.

Import reviews selectable collections with skip/independent-copy/merge policies, structural dedupe and before-import project/template copies; selected originals restored before acceptance; current Brand retained unless explicitly activated.
Search includes canvas and master text, captions, page labels and metadata; format/purpose/review/favorite/folder/tag filters plus sorting.
Gallery selection supports batch folder/tags/add-replace/favorite/export; organized starter templates become custom copies with explicit disclosure.

Validated project/view/folder/page URLs, browser Back/Forward and owner-scoped Continue recent project and page. Explicit page URLs take priority over local owner/project memory; deleted pages fall back safely. Navigation does not save the document, and Undo restores its page and selection without adding browser history entries.
Workspace components/styles can be saved, edited, removed and reused as copies or linked resources across projects; global edits propagate only to editable linked artwork.
Research preflight selects/orders/excludes photos, reports videos, previews output, chooses template/format/Brand and maps content into editable frames.
Supported SVG logos persist as sanitized passive vector paths/gradients with nested opacity and original dimensions; light/dark/universal variants can be tagged and filtered.
Brand asset search spans kits/name/tags, favorites and variants; moves/copies retain originals and metadata.
